body_markdown:
Hi there,


**Getting paid shouldn't be difficult.**


With Truss Keep, a client signs in with their email and a code, picks the bank they saved last time and clicks Pay. They don’t need a password or a Truss account, and they don’t re-enter anything.


[Setting up Truss Keep →](https://try.trusspayments.com/help/article/how-to-pay-your-invoice#h_pay-with-truss-keep)


**Fewer “how do I pay you?” texts.**


Our goal is ensuring your job money goes into your pocket, seamlessly. Truss Keep brings us another step closer to this.


---


**Questions?** Reach out via chat or at[\[email protected\]](https://news.trusspayments.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#2c5f595c5c435e586c585e595f5f5c4d55414942585f024f4341) .


Best,
The Truss Team
